messages:
sam_customer: Hey team — raising a ticket: customer reports generation calls succeed but embeddings return 403. New SSO-provisioned API key. Can someone triage?

alex_cs: Assigned. Can you paste the failing curl + response body?

sam_customer: Repro steps: 1) Create Org SSO key via SCIM -> provisioner. 2) Call text generation endpoint: works. 3) Call embeddings endpoint -> 403.

sam_customer: Curl snippets: ```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/embeddings 
 -H 'Authorization: Bearer <API_KEY>' 
 -d '{"model":"embed-large","input":"test"}'
```

sam_customer: Response: ```json
{ "error": { "code": 403, "message": "missing_scope: embeddings" } }
```

maria_engineering: Hmm. Generation scope present but embeddings missing. Can you confirm token introspection shows scopes? If there's an introspect endpoint we can call.

sam_customer: Ran introspect: ```json
{ "sub":"svc:acct:acme","scopes":["inference:generate","rerank:read"] }
```

alex_cs: That explains it — embeddings not in scopes. Did the SCIM provisioner map embeds -> "embed" or "embeddings"? We've had delimiter mismatches before.

rahul_oncall: Also check for trailing whitespace in the csv/scopes field. Provisioner parser recently treated "; embeddings" differently. I'll pull provisioning logs for tenant id 6881.

ticketbot: Ticket #CS-4521 created and linked to support case. Priority: P2.

alex_cs: If this is provisioner side, quick workaround: generate a service key from console (manual) to restore embeddings for the customer. Maria, can you prepare a safe customer-facing message?

maria_engineering: Draft message: "We see the SSO-provisioned key is missing the embeddings scope due to a provisioning delimiter edge case. We're investigating; temporary workaround is creating a console service key or re-provisioning with corrected scope mapping. Apologies for the disruption." Thoughts? :+1:

rahul_oncall: Logs show provisioner received scopes string: "inference:generate, rerank:read; embeddings" — semicolon before embeddings caused parser to drop that token. Root cause = SCIM-to-provisioner delimiter normalization bug.

alex_cs: Ok action list: 1) Support create manual console key for customer (sam to confirm). 2) Engineering patch provisioner parser for mixed delimiters (maria/rahul to own). 3) Run backfill to detect other tenants with "; embeddings" pattern and re-provision keys.

sam_customer: Confirmed customer accepted manual key workaround. Please keep me in loop on backfill. Thanks all. :pray:

maria_engineering: Will open a PR for parser fix, include unit tests for comma/semicolon/space variants. ETA EOD.

alex_cs: Moving to postmortem if backfill finds >1 tenant. For now closing loop.

sam_customer: Closing triage here, will update ticket with workaround steps and engineering ETA.
